mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% monthly indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5% monthly, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy), a federal funds rate below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary policy response that precedes market correction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL >3.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS <1.0%, or regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production increase exceeding 0.5% indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises >0.5% monthly, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200.0 thousand units signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST <1200.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In strong labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), non-farm payrolls increasing above 150,000 signals robust job creation that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE <4.5% and PAYEMS >150,000, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rates below 0.5% and unemployment below 4.5% indicate accommodative policy in a tight labor market, fueling corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <0.5% and UNRATE <4.5%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
